properties.description: Acceptance check, to be written FAILING before either slice is built. Three designs: P (the parent), A (PART OF P) and B (a peer that A USES across interface I, mirrored into A). A change in B at I, analysed from the hub, must reach A's consumers of I (across) and P's capability that A serves (up), and every result must name its design. Today the radius stops at each design and no row names a design (fact:root-cause-a-blast-radius-stops-at-its-design-by-design-and-nothing-says-where-it-left-2026-10-05), so it fails.
properties.name: A change ripples across a USES link and up a PART OF link, in three designs (parent, part, peer)
